```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(penguins, aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, colour = species)) +
    geom_point(colour = '#99d8c8') + 
    facet_wrap(~ island)

penguins |> 
    filter(island == "Biscoe") |> 
    arrange(desc(body_mass_g)) |> 
    head()

penguins |> 
    filter(!is.na(sex)) |> 
    group_by(species, sex) |> 
    summarise(median = median(flipper_length_mm)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = species, y = median, fill = sex)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    labs(x = "species", y = "median flipper length")

penguins |> 
    subset(!is.na(sex)) |> 
    aggregate(flipper_length_mm ~ species + sex, FUN = 'median') |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = species, y = flipper_length_mm, fill = sex)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    labs(x = "species", y = "median flipper length")

```
